remarks: A rare 3-bedroom opportunity in one of Wilton's most sought-after communities-Wilton Crest. Just moments from Wilton Town Center, this beautifully maintained residence offers spacious living and exceptional convenience. The covered entry is framed by mature creeping hydrangeas and seasonal perennials, creating a warm welcome. Inside, hardwood floors and abundant natural light highlight the open layout centered around a serene interior courtyard with three sets of sliding glass doors. The living room features a wood-burning fireplace and opens to a private balcony, while the dining room flows into a bright white kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinetry. The expansive primary suite includes vaulted ceilings, double closets, and bathroom with a newly tiled stall shower, oversized double vanities, and a jetted tub. Upstairs, two generously sized bedrooms and a full bath with a newly tiled shower/tub combo offer flexible space for guests, work, or hobbies! The attached garage fits a small SUV and provides direct access to a dry, unfinished basement-perfect for future finishing and added equity. Wilton Crest residents enjoy premium amenities including an inground swimming pool, tennis courts, and scenic walking paths along the river into Town. This rare find combines comfort, style, and location!
